pending_interview.question: A mid-sized financial services firm comes to you in your FDE capacity. They process thousands of customer support tickets per day and want to use AI to auto-resolve the most common ones. Their CTO says they want to build their own fine-tuned model in-house because they're worried about sending customer financial data to a third-party AI provider. They have a small ML team (3 engineers), a 90-day deadline to show results to the board, and a compliance team that has not yet been involved. Walk me through how you would scope this engagement, what tradeoffs you'd surface in the first week, and what recommendation you'd make on the build-vs-buy question.
